translations.web: For I rejoiced greatly when brothers came and testified about your truth, even as you walk in truth.
translations.bsb: For I was overjoyed when the brothers came and testified about your devotion to the truth, in which you continue to walk.
translations.kjv: For I rejoiced greatly, when the brethren came and testified of the truth that is in thee, even as thou walkest in the truth.
translations.asv: For I rejoiced greatly, when brethren came and bare witness unto thy truth, even as thou walkest in truth.
